definitions: To rise from bed after sleeping.
To stand up after sitting or lying down.
To dress oneself, often in a particular or elaborate way.
examples: I usually get up at 7 am.
Please get up when your name is called.
They got up a petition against the new policy.
She got herself up in her best clothes for the party.
pastTenses: got up (past simple), got up (past participle)
